belief.title: Recognised without needing to announce itself.
belief.text: NEVMA began as music: a London label releasing every month, and Moments, the nights built around it. Style is the third pillar. It carries the same sign off the stage and into everyday life, in pieces made so rarely that each one is known by its number.

is a gesture, a nod, a sign given with the eyes. The first drop printed that definition as it stands in the dictionary, and it became the house signature: say little, mean it.

children.text: Duties and taxes
UK prices include VAT. Outside the UK, [we pay duties for you (DDP) / your courier may ask for import duties on delivery (DAP)]. Final wording once NEVMA chooses.
Tracking
You get an email with tracking and the numbers of your pieces when your order ships. Signed-in clients see the same in their account.
Limited does not mean final. You can return any piece within 14 days of delivery.
How to return
Tell us within 14 days from the day it arrives: from your account, or by writing to client care with your order number.
Send it back within 14 more days, unworn, with its label and numbered card.
We refund the piece and your original delivery cost to the same card through Viva, within 14 days of receiving it.
What happens to a returned piece
It goes back on sale with its number, and the edition counter goes up by one. We say so on the piece: “returned, checked, back in the edition”.
Exchanges
Because there are only five of each piece, we can’t promise another size. Return the piece, then buy the size you want if it’s still available.
Faulty pieces
Write to us with a photo. We cover return postage and refund or repair, whatever you prefer. Your rights under UK consumer law are not affected.

children.text: 1. Who we are
nevmastyle.[com] is run by [NEVMA company name], registered in England and Wales, company number [number], VAT number [number], [registered address].
2. Your order

Placing an order is an offer to buy. The contract starts when we email you that your payment is confirmed. Pieces are limited: if a piece sells out before your payment is confirmed, we cancel that part of the order and you are not charged for it.
3. Limited editions
Each colourway is made in five pieces. We may limit each client to one of each piece and cancel orders that break that limit or come from automated tools.
4. Prices and payment
Prices are in euros and include VAT [confirm VAT wording with NEVMA's accountant]. Payment is taken by Viva Wallet [legal entity] on its secure page; we never see or store your card details.
5. Delivery
As on the Shipping and delivery page. Risk passes to you on delivery.
6. Your right to cancel
You may cancel within 14 days of delivery without giving a reason, under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013. See Returns and exchanges.
7. Faulty goods and liability
Your statutory rights apply. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
8. Law
These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.

children.text: Who looks after your data
[NEVMA company name] is the controller of the personal data collected on NEVMA Style. Contact: [privacy@nevma…].
What we collect and why
Order and delivery details, to sell and ship your pieces (contract).
Account details and wishlist, when you create an account (contract).
Drop alerts and newsletter, only if you ask for them (consent; unsubscribe in every email).
Messages to client care, to reply to you (legitimate interest).
Analytics, only if you accept cookies (consent).
Who we share it with

Shopify (shop, checkout and accounts), Viva (payments), our couriers, Vercel (website hosting), Sanity (website content, wishlist and requests), Resend (email), Cloudflare (security). Some are outside the UK and are covered by approved safeguards.
How long we keep it
Orders for 6 years for tax; accounts until you delete them; notify-me requests until the drop opens.
Your rights
Access, correction, deletion, objection and portability under UK GDPR. You can also complain to the ICO.
We use a few cookies to run the shop, and analytics only if you say yes.
